projects_description5:
The Vintage-Car platform connects vehicle owners, storage providers, repair shops, and
spare parts suppliers. Vehicle owners can search for suitable parking spaces, request quotes, and book additional services. Storage providers offer their parking spaces and services and communicate with vehicle owners. In addition,
storage providers can partner with repair shops for maintenance and repairs. Car owners
also have the option to find and reserve spare parts from spare-part suppliers.
The platform facilitates communication and the exchange
of information among all parties involved.
